name: Telegram Bot API
tagline: Bots, messages, files, webhooks, and chat automation.
shortDescription: Telegram Bot API exposes HTTP methods for sending messages, managing chats, files, webhooks, payments, and updates.
agentSummary: Agents can operate bots and chat workflows with a straightforward HTTP API and webhook/polling model.
bestFor: Bot notifications, chat automations, support intake, and lightweight messaging workflows.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Chat privacy, group permissions, and accidental broadcasts need safeguards. Outbound messages, SMS, email deliverability, consent, unsubscribe behavior, private chats, and customer-facing replies need approval, throttling, and audit logs. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Bot API is free; paid platform features are separate.
authModel: Bot tokens from BotFather and webhook secrets.
accountCreation: Telegram account and BotFather bot creation.
browserSupport: Bot setup is chat-first rather than browser-first.

capabilities.detail: Bot API documents methods for messages, chats, files, updates, and webhooks.
Docs are compact, stable, and HTTP-oriented.
Bot API is free; paid platform features are separate.
Telegram account and BotFather bot creation.
Bot setup is chat-first rather than browser-first.
Private test bots and test chats support safer development.
